title: Lesson 25 · A studio that fits you

lines.sub: This is Lira's Academy, lesson twenty-five — “A studio that fits you”.
lines.tts: This is Lira's Academy, lesson twenty-five — A studio that fits you.

lines.sub: All I need is tasks, notes and my people. And here — clients, mailings, websites…
lines.tts: All I need is tasks, notes and my people. And here — clients, mailings, websites…

lines.sub: Tap “Minimum” — and the menu shows only what's yours. Hidden sections don't even load.
lines.tts: Tap Minimum — and the menu shows only what's yours. Hidden sections don't even load.

lines.sub: In “Appearance” — “What to show”: “Everything”, “For myself” — without work — and “Minimum”.
lines.tts: In Appearance — What to show: Everything, For myself — without work — and Minimum.

lines.sub: Or with switches — a whole group or a single section. Hidden things keep working: reminders still arrive.
lines.tts: Or with switches — a whole group or a single section. Hidden things keep working: reminders still arrive.

lines.sub: Need a hidden section? Find it with search on “Home” and bring it back in one tap.
lines.tts: Need a hidden section? Find it with search on Home and bring it back in one tap.

lines.sub: Slow computer? “Light view”: no blur or glass — and the studio responds faster.
lines.tts: Slow computer? Light view: no blur or glass — and the studio responds faster.

lines.sub: All of this is in the studio, the “Appearance” section, at the very top.
